roles.producer: Describes effects; no arbitrary effect inference or trusted SaaS identity follows.
roles.registry_publisher: Publishes revisions and evidence. No registry service is implemented by the assessed targets.
roles.evidence_checker: Checks declared local bindings within a finite profile, not signatures, CEL, observations or complete bounds.
roles.consumer: Interprets a description within configured support; acceptance is not authorization.
roles.authority: Owns current grants, expiry, revocation, quota and replay. Not implemented by any assessed target.
roles.enforcement_point: Controls dispatch. Not implemented by any assessed target; Bench policy/gate integrations are outside this matrix.
roles.observer: Binds provider outcomes to occurrences. Not implemented by any assessed target.
